description: Maximality does not apply to the reconstruction's roots. c restores its [T] after y → A, although y → A T is longer, because a restoration reads a token and omits nothing. So c is a second reading (stage-wide maximal; engine §7.7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only maximal
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T] [T]
%rule b A [T] [T] [T]
%rule c y [T] T
%rule y A | A T
